AUTHORITY: PI 2026-09-12: 'Checkpoint-over-time crossover -- if intermediate checkpoints exist, test a small set of them on a cheap exploratory seed block, not to claim a result, but to answer: did specialization appear earlier and disappear later? That would tell us whether the fix is early stopping / checkpoint selection versus better training pressure.'
QUESTION: Does the specialization margin of the B3-3 specialist pair exist at an earlier point in training and then collapse by the terminal checkpoint, or is it flat and near-zero throughout?
WHY_THIS_QUESTION_SHARPENED_TODAY: The training-curve diagnostic showed the B3-3 vanilla pair NEVER saturated: both specialists sat in a 0.63-0.74 rolling win-rate band for the entire 1M-step budget and neither ever reached 0.80. So the C2-style explanation ('they became high-win-rate generalists too early') does NOT apply to B3-3, yet B3-3 still produced delta_A=+0.047, delta_B=+0.016 at its terminal checkpoint. Either a margin existed mid-training and was lost, or it never formed. Those imply different fixes, and only this measurement separates them.

POLICIES_AND_POLES.track: B3-3 vanilla (the certified-pole track; NOT C2, NOT role-preservation)
POLICIES_AND_POLES.Pole_B: B3-3_lockdef10_2v1.json (SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1) -- the certified candidate genome, NOT canonical OP7
POLICIES_AND_POLES.pairing_rule: pi_A and pi_B must ALWAYS be taken from the SAME training step. delta is only defined for a matched pair.

CHECKPOINT_LADDER.why_sparse_and_even: an evenly spaced ladder localises WHERE a margin would peak, which is what an early-stopping prescription needs. Choosing points after seeing a curve would be checkpoint shopping.
CHECKPOINT_LADDER.terminal_included: the 1,000,000-step point is included so the trajectory has an internal anchor measured on the SAME block as every other point
CHECKPOINT_LADDER.terminal_is_not_the_sealed_number: the sealed terminal result (delta_A=+0.047, delta_B=+0.016) was measured on block 16700001-128 at n=128. The terminal point measured here uses a different, smaller block and will differ. These two numbers MUST NOT be compared as though they were the same measurement; only within-ladder comparisons are meaningful.

SEEDS.disjointness_verified: grep for 17300001/17300024 across artifacts/**/*.json at freeze time: ZERO hits. Disjoint from the sealed B3 crossover block 16700001-128 and from every other spent block.
SEEDS.why_shared: every checkpoint is scored on the identical seeds so the trajectory is paired within-seed across training steps, not confounded by different episode draws

DESIGN.delta_A: V(pi_A, A) - V(pi_B, A) at the same training step
DESIGN.delta_B: V(pi_B, B) - V(pi_A, B) at the same training step
DESIGN.estimated_runtime: ~5-6 h at the observed 4v4 pace (~40 s/ep), subject to machine load

POWER_DISCLOSED_BEFORE_RUNNING.resolution: at n=24 one flipped episode moves delta by 0.042; the 95% CI half-width on a paired delta is roughly +/-0.20
POWER_DISCLOSED_BEFORE_RUNNING.can_detect: a LARGE early margin (delta of roughly 0.25 or more) that later collapses
POWER_DISCLOSED_BEFORE_RUNNING.cannot_detect: a modest early margin (e.g. delta ~0.10) -- it would be statistically indistinguishable from the terminal value
POWER_DISCLOSED_BEFORE_RUNNING.consequence: a flat trajectory here is evidence AGAINST a large transient margin, NOT proof that no margin ever existed

THE_CENTRAL_FENCE_CHECKPOINT_SHOPPING.rule: This scan is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. It does not license promoting any intermediate checkpoint into any confirmatory result, paper claim, comparison table, or downstream distillation.
THE_CENTRAL_FENCE_CHECKPOINT_SHOPPING.if_an_intermediate_checkpoint_looks_bett: that is a HYPOTHESIS, not a finding. Acting on it requires a NEW prospectively frozen experiment with its own fresh seed block and its own pre-declared checkpoint rule, scored once. The terminal-checkpoint rule remains in force for every existing confirmatory record.
THE_CENTRAL_FENCE_CHECKPOINT_SHOPPING.why_this_fence_matters_here: scanning checkpoints and keeping the best one is exactly the selection procedure this program has refused everywhere else. The sealed B3-3 FAIL stands regardless of what this scan shows.

PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.large_early_margin_then_collapse: specialization forms and is subsequently lost -> early stopping, specialization-margin checkpointing, or regularisation become plausible interventions, to be tested as a NEW frozen experiment
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.flat_near_zero_throughout: no large transient margin existed -> the fix is upstream in acquisition (curriculum, warm-start, objective pressure), not checkpoint selection
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.margin_grows_monotonically_but_stays_sma: specialization is forming but too slowly for the budget -> longer training or stronger pressure, not early stopping
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.noisy_non_monotone: no detectable trajectory at n=24 -- report as underpowered and do not read a shape into it
